name: smith elevated split squat
description: A split squat with the rear foot raised on a bench, done on a smith machine. It targets the quads and glutes with extra stability.
instructions: Place a bench behind the smith machine and rest your back foot on it.
Position the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Lower your hips until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front foot.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
